name: Fleet overview
title: Your whole fleet. In one view.
description: Bring your vessels together in a shared operational picture. Move from a fleet-wide overview to the vessel and measurements you want to explore.
bullets: Find the vessel you need to review.
Give crew and shore teams a shared starting point.

image.alt: Fleet overview world map showing vessel positions coloured by status over a global wind and weather layer.

name: VesselGPT
title: Ask more of your vessel data.
description: Planned LLM integration brings a conversational layer to platform modules. Ask for context and interpretation of the data, and discuss customised graphs and notifications.
bullets: Explore what the data means in the context of a module.
Discuss the questions and views that matter to your operation.

image.alt: VesselGPT conversation alongside a vessel consumption dashboard, with analysis of fuel use, operating modes and weather impact.

name: Vessel Status
title: Know what is happening onboard.
description: Follow operational mode, fuel consumption, power production and consumption, weather and vessel position in one real-time view.
bullets: Monitor the vessel in its operational context.
Play back historical voyages to review what happened.

image.alt: Vessel Status interface with vessel position, weather map and live operational measurements.

name: Operations
title: Understand every operation. Improve the next.
description: Dipai’s mode detection algorithm logs vessel operations and brings their performance into context. Review individual operations and benchmark fuel efficiency against a dynamic baseline.
bullets: Evaluate performance operation by operation.
Build a dynamic fuel baseline after one to two quarters of historical data.

image.alt: Operations interface showing fuel-baseline deviations by operating mode, operation records, performance timelines and a vessel route map.

name: Consumption
title: Turn fuel data into better practices.
description: Establish and follow up on fuel-consumption best practices for each operational mode. Track the equipment in use and see how performance develops over time.
bullets: Trend fuel use, including tonnes per day and fuel efficiency.
Bring consumption KPIs together in Dipai reports.

image.alt: Consumption interface showing fuel and emissions metrics, consumption by operational mode, weather impact and vessel routes.

name: Emissions
title: Know your emissions. Simplify compliance.
description: Dipai brings emissions monitoring and regulatory reporting together in one platform. Track vessel carbon intensity, understand your allowance requirements and streamline compliance with end-to-end support—from data collection to verification.
bullets: CII — Calculate vessel carbon intensity using the applicable IMO methodology for each supported vessel type.
EU MRV & IMO DCS — Simplify reporting with continuous API transfer of operational data to your verifier and hands-on resolution of data-quality issues and warnings.
EU ETS — Monitor emissions within scope and calculate the corresponding emissions allowance requirements.

image.alt: MRV playback report showing a vessel track across Europe with geofences, port calls and logged events, plus summary counts and a playback timeline.

name: SEEMP
title: Build your next plan on real performance.
description: Review last year’s performance with historical data and analytics, then set realistic targets for the year ahead in your Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan.
bullets: Choose from around 10–20 default actions per vessel.
Create custom actions and follow performance against your plan.

image.alt: SEEMP action plan showing operational targets for DP, port and transit, performance trends and team discussions.

name: Condition-based Maintenance
title: See the signs. Plan with confidence.
description: Combine machinery load profiles, onboard engine performance tests, anomaly detection and VesselGPT to identify wear and performance deviations early and trigger condition-based maintenance jobs.
bullets: Give crew and shore teams a shared view of machinery condition.
Support maintenance decisions with AI recommendations.

image.alt: Condition-based maintenance dashboard showing engine loads, running hours, fuel-consumption trends and overhaul intervals.

name: Efficiency
title: See what made a difference.
description: Compare vessel efficiency before and after hull or propeller cleaning, new coatings or machinery changes. Assess events using comparable operating conditions.
bullets: Filter by operating mode, draft, geolocation and weather.
Separate the effect of an intervention from changes in operating conditions.

image.alt: Efficiency interface comparing propulsion power and vessel speed, with hydrodynamic performance trends across quarters.

name: Historical Data
title: Follow the signal back in time.
description: Build your own detailed analysis by trending the sensor measurements you choose. Operational-mode colours add context to the measurements.
bullets: Explore historical measurements in a shared timeline.
Interpret changes alongside the vessel’s operational modes.

image.alt: Historical Data interface showing power trends over time with background colours indicating operational modes.

name: Data Download & API
title: Your data. Ready for your next use.
description: Give designated users direct access to sensor-data downloads, or use Dipai’s REST API for a continuous stream of data into your own tools.
bullets: Download sensor data directly from the platform.
Connect data to your wider analysis and reporting workflows.

image.alt: Data download interface with selected sensors, date range and a tabular data preview.
